row.team_price_text: Essentials: credits-based, unlimited users (Flex estimate $3.14/TB scanned)
row.evidence: Sumo Logic documents a SCIM User Management API ('allows you to provision users to Sumo Logic from SCIM provisioning providers') with Okta, Entra ID and OneLogin guides, but no page names the plan that includes it.
row.notes: Usage (credit) priced with unlimited users; per-user fields null. The pricing table ticks 'Single sign-on with SAML' and 'Management APIs' (manage users via API) for every plan including Essentials, and SAML docs list Essentials, but SCIM itself is not named on the pricing page or given an availability table, so status stays unknown (rule 1a); likely free if Management APIs covers SCIM. SCIM 2.0 Users only (no Groups), roles via a roles attribute, access-key Basic/Bearer auth, SAML set up first. Okta/Entra catalogue apps are SSO only; provisioning uses custom SCIM apps.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.price_text: Credits-based (Flex pricing estimate $3.14 per TB scanned, US); free trial, self-serve
plans.notes: Unlimited users; priced by data scanned/ingested, not per user. SAML and Management APIs rows are ticked for every column in the plan table.

auth.token_source: Access key (access ID + key), preferably created on a service account; Basic auth or Base64(<access ID>:<access key>) as bearer token
auth.notes: Executing account needs all User Management role capabilities.

endpoints.notes: Only /v1/scim/Users and /v1/scim/Users/{id} appear in the OpenAPI spec; no Groups resource.

operations.notes: Roles are assigned through the SCIM roles attribute instead of groups.

deprovision.data_retained: Unassigning the user in the IdP deactivates the Sumo Logic user: their dashboards, scheduled searches, scheduled views and access keys are deactivated, monitors keep running; content is kept. Deleting a user (SCIM DELETE or UI) can transfer content to another user.
deprovision.notes: Plans have unlimited users, so seats are not a factor. A deactivated user cannot be re-provisioned until the old user is deleted.

roles.how: SCIM roles attribute; values must exactly match Sumo Logic role names; IdP app roles map to Sumo roles

rate_limits.text: Four API requests per second (240 per minute) per user; 10 concurrent requests per access key.

limitations.text: Only one email address per user is accepted.
After an IdP unassign deactivates a user, reassigning errors until the old user is deleted in Sumo Logic.
No SCIM Groups endpoint; Okta and Entra setups use custom (non-catalogue) apps.

scim.notes: SCIM is part of the public Sumo Logic REST API (SCIM User Management tag). Docs say to set up SAML first so the IdP app can connect. No plan is named for SCIM.

methods: access key (HTTP Basic: access ID + access key)
auth.notes: Executing user needs User Management role capabilities.

endpoints.purpose: Assign a role to a user
Remove a role from a user

audit_log_api.notes: Audit events are written to the Audit Index and searched with the Search Job API; a dedicated audit-log REST API was not found.

rate_limits.text: Four API requests per second (240 per minute) per user; 10 concurrent requests per access key.

okta.notes: OIN 'Sumo Logic' app lists SAML and SWA only; Sumo's SCIM guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM provisioning enabled.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO; SCIM is set up through a non-gallery app.

onelogin.notes: Sumo's guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Enterprise)' app.

searched: https://www.sumologic.com/pricing (incl. expanded plan table in rendered DOM)
open_questions: Which plans include the SCIM User Management API is not stated (pricing table has no SCIM row; SCIM docs have no availability table).
Token expiry is not documented (access keys).
Whether SCIM deactivation ends active sessions is not documented.
Reactivation via SCIM (active=true) is not documented.
Google Workspace and JumpCloud catalogue apps not checked.
